text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Germany's President Roman Herzog pay homage to Tunisia's role for peace and stability on the Mediterranean.
- Average money market rate cut by one percentage point, to 7.81 percent from 8.1 percent, effective November 12.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali and his wife visit Germany
-UNESCO's director terms President Ben Ali as a man who welcomes talks.
